items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: I think he would write the chords down for Hillary and... Yeah. Her name was Hillary.

ctx.x: But did they read, I mean, on a job?

Well, they didn't read too much. What would have happened... But Old Man Martel was a good musician. He would buy a lead sheet of the leading tunes. For instance, the first time I ever played "Sand" in my life was with him. He would buy the lead sheet. And he would write, write a part for Bert, a trumpet part. And I don't think he ever wrote anything for Dayton. I think he would write the chords down for Hillary and...
